_note: M4 V5: the town's districts (docs/M4_VARIETY.md section 10). Each run lays out the town from these: your home district at the bottom, the citadel at the top, Ministry Row always just below it, the rest mixed in between. 'name' is a PLACEHOLDER until the user names it (user 2026-11-26: Claude gives the vibe, the user names it, lore written together). 'vibe' = what it has and who lives there; 'colours' from art bible 16 where it has them; 'key' = the building type you take to open the district; 'places' = what kinds of targets turn up there.

canal.name: CANAL ESTATE
canal.vibe: Where your garage is. Barges and locks, brick warehouses, Dobrev Freight on the water. Old dockers, their widows, kids who run messages for a coin. The Canal Sisters keep a clinic in a flooded basement nobody admits exists.

mill.name: MILL HOUSING
mill.vibe: Rows of identical blocks built for the textile mill. Laundry over every street, a siren for each shift change. Everyone works the same hours, so everyone knows who doesn't.

tram.name: OLD TRAM
tram.vibe: The dead tram depot and the arcades round it. The Tram Yard market after curfew, smugglers, card games in the old waiting rooms. The fixer grew up here and still owns half the stalls.

hill.name: HILL STEPS
hill.vibe: Streets that are staircases, up the slope to the radio mast. Churches, teachers, old families. The Lamp prints its paper on a church copier at night.

foundry.name: THE FOUNDRY
foundry.vibe: The smelter and the slag heaps, the refinery's fence along the river. Men with burned forearms who remember the strike of '71. The Foundry boys drink in one bar and nobody else does.

rail.name: RAIL FRINGE
rail.vibe: Shacks along the rail yards, people the city doesn't count. Patrols are rough here and nobody files complaints. Cheap to recruit, hard to protect.

ring.name: MARKET RING
ring.vibe: The ring road of shops and cafes round the old centre. Checkpoints at every crossing, informers at every counter. Busy by day, dead after curfew.

ministry.name: MINISTRY ROW
ministry.vibe: Marble offices, flags, the Central Police HQ, a camera on every lamp post. The last ring before the citadel. You don't walk here; you're walked.

citadel.name: THE CITADEL
citadel.vibe: The seat of the regime. Granite columns, tapestries of the Marshal, a hall built to make you feel small. The end goal: everyone you have goes in at once, like the storm of Berlin in 1945. Maybe only you and a handful come out.
